scope: Gold-blind assistant-turn extraction experiment over the six previously missed single-session-assistant heldout cases.
important_caveats: This is directional evidence only: it was run only on the six prior assistant misses, so it measures potential upside but not full-shard regression risk.

The persisted case artifacts contain top-k retrieved facts, not the full durable fact store. Missing gold strings in retrieved facts should not be overclaimed as extraction misses until the store is inspected or a larger recall ablation is run.
Residue reprobes had cloud_query_not_ready errors for several cases, so residue counters should not be treated as a strong contamination proof for this shard.
The experiment shows normal assistant extraction improved this slice from 0/6 to 2/6, but it is not sufficient by itself for assistant-answer parity.
next_steps: Inspect durable fact stores for the four remaining misses to classify extraction miss versus retrieval miss.
Run a recall ablation with larger top_k/max_facts on the four misses.
Before adopting broader assistant extraction, run a full fixed 50-case flag-off versus flag-on comparison and segment by question_type.
